```{r unit-analysis-parameters}
# ---- Hold trimming -------------------------------------------------------
# Seconds discarded from the start/end of each manifest hold, to drop the
# hand still settling and starting to move away again. At 1 Hz these are
# also sample counts.
settle_s    <- 10
tail_trim_s <- 5

# Holds left with fewer samples than this after trimming get flagged.
min_samples_per_step <- 10

# ---- Sensor ---------------------------------------------------------------
# TLV493D full-scale range, microtesla (+/- 130 mT). Readings at or above
# `saturation_frac` of this are clipping and are flagged.
sensor_range_uT <- 130000
saturation_frac <- 0.95

# ---- Background -----------------------------------------------------------
# Subtract the ambient field vector measured during `n_magnets = 0` holds.
subtract_background <- TRUE

# ---- Misc -----------------------------------------------------------------
deployment_tz <- "America/Los_Angeles"   # timezone the DS3231 was set in
output_dir    <- "output"
```

